E0760

`#Context` field uses `=` instead of `:` (D-CTX1, S17)

What

`#Context` field uses `=` instead of `:` (D-CTX1, S17)

Why

The registered parser rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0760

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0760: tests/ui/context_eq_rejected.stderr.

Error [E0760]: context fields are set with `:`, not `=`
  --> tests/ui/context_eq_rejected.jet:7:24
    |
  7 |     #Context(allocator = arena) {
    |                        ^
 Why: `=` is reassignment (S17); the `name: value` form sets a context field
 Fix: write `#Context(allocator: …) { … }`
